title: Sky check
instructions: Step outside and take a photo of today's sky.

alternatives.text: Photograph the sky through a window.

title: Something blue
instructions: Find something blue outdoors and photograph it.

alternatives.text: Find something blue you can see from a window or doorway.

proof: A photo of a blue object outdoors.

title: Lunch al fresco
instructions: Eat a meal or snack outside.

alternatives.text: Eat by an open window or on a balcony.

proof: A photo of your food outdoors.

title: Bird spotter
instructions: Spot three birds outside and photograph one of them.

alternatives.text: Spot birds from a window and photograph one.

title: New park
instructions: Walk or roll to a park you haven't visited this month.

alternatives.text: Visit any green space with a step-free path.

title: Litter pick
instructions: Pick up five pieces of litter outside and put them in a bin.

alternatives.text: Tidy up litter on your street or building entrance.

proof: A photo of the litter in a bag or bin.

title: Find water
instructions: Photograph any water outdoors: a fountain, river, lake or the sea.

alternatives.text: Photograph a puddle, pond or water feature nearby.

title: Shoreline with a friend
instructions: Visit a shoreline, lake or river with a friend.

alternatives.text: Visit a park pond or fountain with a friend.

title: 20-minute cleanup
instructions: Spend 20 minutes cleaning up litter in a public place.

alternatives.text: Spend 20 minutes tidying a shared outdoor space near you.

proof: A photo of the litter you collected.

alternatives.text: Watch the sunrise from a window or balcony.
